entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5864955727424819200 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/vw-cen/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv; cross-identification HIP 66189: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia+DR3+5864955727424819200. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VW Cen: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3687.2 +/- 169.6 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3687.2 +/- 169.6 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2386 +/- 0.0158 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06), 15.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -6.005, -1.247 mas/yr. Radial velocity: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 5864955727424819200 (quality A), from 2012ApJ...748..107P; Gaia DR3 measures none (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...748..107P/abstract).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 88.1 +/- 4 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, VW Cen: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 88.1 +/- 4 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 61,291,170 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4750 +/- 168 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 247, Name='VW Cen', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4750 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 5864955727424819200: 4 G-band harmonics of a 15.037396908377152 d period, peak-to-peak 0.830 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.06 of a cycle there.
